context:
- For w1: emit the compatibility matrix as a YAML file at
  benchbox/platforms/pg_mooncake_type_compat.yaml, version-tagged. Read the
  pg_mooncake changelog/release notes for the version in use to enumerate
  supported column types. Do not modify the adapter itself.
- For w2: add an optional MigrationPhase dataclass to benchbox/core/results/models.py
  (alongside existing SetupPhase fields). In pg_mooncake.py, add a run_migration_phase()
  method that executes ALTER TABLE ... SET ACCESS METHOD columnar, records wall time
  and storage delta, and returns a MigrationPhase instance or None. The runner skips
  this phase when not configured - use the NOT_RUN stub pattern (status="not_run",
  duration_ms=0) already present in benchbox/core/runner/runner.py (LifecyclePhases).
  Update _build_phases_block() in schema.py to conditionally include the migration
  phase using the "Omit Empty" principle.
- For w3: add a NativeComparison dataclass to benchbox/core/results/models.py with
  a list of per-query delta entries {query_id, pg_duckdb_ms, duckdb_ms, delta_ms}.
  In pg_duckdb.py, add an optional run_native_comparison() method triggered by a
  --platform-option compare_native=true flag. Serialize via a new top-level
  "comparisons" key in schema.py using the "Omit Empty" pattern (omit if None).
  Do NOT add --compare-native as a top-level CLI flag - use the existing
  --platform-option K=V mechanism already in benchbox run.
description:
Advanced benchmarking features for PostgreSQL extension adapters that go
beyond basic query execution.

From pg-mooncake-platform-adapter (completed 2026-02-15):
- Data type compatibility matrix documentation
- Heap-to-columnstore migration benchmarking (measuring conversion overhead)

From pg-duckdb-platform-adapter (completed 2026-02-15):
- pg_duckdb vs native DuckDB automated comparison reports

These are benchmarking enhancements, not integration tests (those are in
cloud-integration-test-infrastructure).

anti_patterns.why: pull from pg_mooncake release notes or a live information_schema query, so the matrix stays accurate across versions

anti_patterns.dont: modify pg_mooncake or pg_duckdb connection/auth code
anti_patterns.why: these are read-only enhancements; touching connection paths risks breaking live adapters with no benefit

preserves.behavior: pg_duckdb adapter: existing query execution and schema load paths
pg_mooncake adapter: existing query execution, connection management, and TPC-H/TPC-DS run paths

verifications.description: Existing pg_mooncake tests still pass after any changes
Existing pg_duckdb tests still pass after any changes

work_units.summary: Write pg_mooncake type compatibility matrix to pg_mooncake_type_compat.yaml - enumerate supported column types for the pinned version from release notes
Add optional migration phase to pg_mooncake adapter - ALTER TABLE heap→columnar, record wall time and storage delta, emit as a phase result in the result bundle
Add pg_duckdb vs native DuckDB comparison output - run identical TPC-H queries on both platforms, write per-query timing delta JSON into the result bundle
